document: Outgoing (issued) Hungarian invoice, where our company is the SUPPLIER
glossary: Document type: Outgoing (issued) Hungarian invoice, where our company is the SUPPLIER. Field names are English identifiers; the document text is verbatim, usually Hungarian.

field_specs.supplier_name: the supplier name as printed on the document
field_specs.supplier_tax_id: the supplier tax id as printed on the document (Kiallito HU adoszama (BestixCom: 12345678-2-42), formatum ########-#-##)
field_specs.buyer_name: the buyer name as printed on the document (Vevo (customer) neve)
field_specs.buyer_tax_id: the buyer tax id as printed on the document (Vevo adoszama / VAT registration No., ha szerepel)
field_specs.buyer_address: the buyer address as printed on the document (Vevo cime, ahogy a szamlan szerepel)
field_specs.invoice_number: the invoice number as printed on the document (Szamla sorszama (pl. BD012, BESE0018))
field_specs.issue_date: the issue date as printed on the document (Kiallitas datuma, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD)
field_specs.fulfillment_date: the fulfillment date as printed on the document (Teljesites/delivery datuma, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD)
field_specs.due_date: the due date as printed on the document (Fizetesi hatarido, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD)
field_specs.currency: the currency as printed on the document (A szamla fo penzneme, ISO 4217 (USD, EUR, HUF))
field_specs.net_total: the net total as printed on the document
field_specs.vat_total: the vat total as printed on the document (AFA osszege STRING-kent (AAM/0% eseten "0" lehet))
field_specs.gross_total: the gross total as printed on the document
field_specs.payment_iban: the payment iban as printed on the document (Fizetesi IBAN/bankszamlaszam, ahogy a szamlan szerepel)
